description: SSI Builders - Auto-sync MCP Server before GITHUB releases

user-prompt-submit.command:
bash -c '
USER_MSG="$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT"
CWD="$CLAUDE_CWD"

# Check if user triggered GITHUB command
if echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "(GITHUB|github|git push.*tag)"; then
  echo "🔄 Pre-GITHUB: Syncing MCP Server..." >&2
  
  # Change to MCP directory and sync
  cd /Users/martinmollay/Development/ssi-builders-mcp
  npm run sync >&2 2>&1
  
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "✅ MCP Server synchronized successfully!" >&2
  else
    echo "❌ MCP sync failed! Continuing with GITHUB anyway..." >&2
  fi
  
  cd "$CWD"
fi

# Model selection (same as global)
if echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "(refactor|architect|GITHUB|supabase.*query)"; then
  echo "model:sonnet"
elif echo "$USER_MSG" | grep -qiE "(fix|update|add|css|i18n|component)"; then
  echo "model:haiku"
else
  echo "model:haiku"
fi
'
